text:
sarah: noticed invoice-preview +1.8% for some EU tenants this morning, not showing on dashboards yet
mike: saw a small spike of late-arrival events around 02:05 UTC from metering consumer after the connector deploy
anita: which connector change?
jon: priority-queue-connector PR switched ack behavior to ack_on_commit and added retry buffer
mike: reproduction locally: slower downstream + new ack flow = reorder, preview counts include late events attributed to current window
anita: suspect fingerprint/dedupe id isn't set until commit path, so earlier enqueue has empty fingerprint -> double-count when commit sets it
sarah: proposed short-term mitigation: ignore events with ingest_latency_ms > 30s in invoice-preview (canary 5%)
mike: I can ship hotfix for preview aggregator, will emit metric preview_filter_applied_count
jon: long-term: compute dedupe_id before enqueue (move fingerprinting to proxy) or materialize stable dedupe id at source
sarah: also add 'preview_confidence' metric and tooltip in Console so PMs/Finance understand suppressed events
anita: I'll start fingerprint refactor PR and add integration tests for reordering/dedupe
mike: will open hotfix PR and stage canary
deploy-bot: deploy queued: hotfix/preview-filter -> staging
deploy-bot: deploy succeeded to staging (build 5482)
sarah: create alert billing.preview_delta > 1% for 15m -> #eng-oncall + #finance-watch and add runbook link
jon: I'll add a small Console card under Billing Preview for suppressed-event examples
sarah: tl;dr: hotfix in staging, fingerprint refactor in progress, console UX + alerts planned; will loop finance and product
mike: also adding nightly reconciliation job to compute late-arrival corrections (backlog)
anita: assigning tasks, will pair with jon tomorrow for dashboard copy
sarah: thanks all, will close thread after staging looks stable
